personality_one_liner: A warm, energetic, and highly accessible matching experience crossing the approachability of a dating app with the trust of a local job board.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 44pt), comfortable paddings, intentional whitespace. Cards use md/lg margins to allow background to breathe.

do's: Use blur on the bottom tab bar where the swipe stack scrolls behind it.
Use blur on the top sticky browse-context / filter chips if they overlay the card stack.
Apply glassmorphism to Floating Action Buttons (Like/Pass) that sit over the swipe card.
dont's: Do not use glass inside the forms or chat lists.
Do not blur primary CTA buttons.

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: Welcomes users and facilitates Google Login.
screens.layout: Responsive red-gradient hero with an organic cloud of 16 softly translucent, varied-size icons representing Indonesian job categories, followed by the Kerjo handshake mark with 'Kerjo' directly underneath. Avoid rigid grids and corporate symmetry. A rounded white surface continues the hierarchy with the static headline 'Biar kerja ketemu yang cocok' and the smaller secondary line 'Sesama warga, saling bantu.' The tagline enters once in a calm 1–2 second sequence: the first phrase fades naturally, a tiny connection accent appears, then the second phrase gently slides and fades in before remaining stable. Do not show a Kerjo icon beside the tagline. Follow with a simple Google login CTA and the free-for-workers-and-employers note.

screens.name: Swipe Stack (Home)
screens.purpose: Core discovery feed for shortlisting/applying to jobs or workers.

states.empty: Illustration of a relaxing scene + 'No more nearby options! Check back later.' + Refresh CTA

screens.layout: Top layer: Compact three-way segmented filter (Semua, Pekerja, Lowongan) with equal-width options, followed by a short row containing three common category chips and Lainnya. Lainnya opens a bottom-sheet grid for the remaining categories. The filter bottom-sheet contains Tipe Kerja only; distance, payment, and experience come from listing/profile data, while location is controlled from the header icon. Semua interleaves job and worker cards while the other filters show one card type. In Lowongan, every authenticated user sees a contextual Pasang Kerja action; an owner-only Pelamar pill appears directly on their own job card. Middle layer: Full-bleed portrait cards (radius lg 24px) with a bottom gradient and an always-visible compact summary for distance, payment, and experience. On web, mouse-over or keyboard focus expands these three values into a labeled information panel without changing drag/swipe behavior. Bottom layer: Floating circular buttons for Reject (X) and Accept (Heart/Apply), plus a three-item navigation bar for Profil, Jelajah, and Chat.

screens.name: Post a Job
screens.purpose: Quick form to create a new job listing.

states.error: Form validation errors displayed below fields in error color

screens.layout: Guided card-based single-column form shared with profile creation. Labels sit above controls. Inputs use surfaceTertiary with a subtle border and brandPrimary focus state. Section icons, progress, selected states, and the sticky CTA use Kerjo red; cards stay white.

screens.name: Match Celebration
screens.purpose: Animated overlay when a mutual swipe occurs.
screens.layout: Full-screen absolute overlay with surfaceInverse background (90% opacity). Central red/white category graphic with friendly 'Cocok!' display typography. Two stacked buttons: 'Kirim Pesan' (brandPrimary) and 'Lanjut Swipe' (outlined/muted).

screens.name: Chat & Review
screens.purpose: List of matches and 1:1 conversation view with completion tracking.
screens.layout: Standard chat UI. The 1:1 view features a sticky header with the matched user's avatar and a prominent 'Mark Job as Done' button, triggering a bottom-sheet for leaving a star rating and casual review.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Detailed view showing trust scores and user testimonials.
screens.layout: Static branded hero with centered Kerjo lockup, profile photo, greeting, identity details, verification status, and low-opacity red/pink work icons. One independent vertical scroller below contains role selection, completeness, profile details, activity, history, reviews, and logout. Use only Kerjo red/pink/white chrome; green is reserved for verified success.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Plus Jakarta Sans throughout UI: Regular/Medium for body and SemiBold/Bold for page and section hierarchy. Reserve Fredoka SemiBold for the Kerjo wordmark and marketing headlines.

All product chrome uses the canonical brandPrimary, brandSecondary, brandTertiary, white/neutral surfaces, and semantic colors only. Category icons use red/pink/white rather than independent rainbow palettes.

Implement the full-bleed portrait swipe card with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) at the bottom to ensure text readability over varying photos.
Place the action buttons (Reject/Accept) as floating elements layered on top of the swipe card near the bottom, utilizing glassmorphism.
Always provide loading, empty, and error states for all screens. Set flex: 1 and use a centered layout for these states.
All tap targets (buttons, filter chips, list rows) must be at least 44x44pt.
In the Chat view, place the 'Mark Job as Done' button in the chat header or pinned at the top of the chat to keep it always accessible.
Integrate haptic feedback for swipe interactions and tab changes.
Follow the accessibility guidelines for density and clear labeling; ensure grouping of layout elements avoids clutter for low-literacy users.
